item.title: Incarico post-doc: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 post-doc research contract - Department of History and Cultures (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-05 Sociologia generale

Title of the project:" The Historic City Centre in Transition: New Populations, Urban Practices, and Socio-Spatial Inequalities ". The research activity will focus on the design, implementation and analysis of a multidimensional study investigating the representations, perceptions and patterns of use of Bologna’s historic center, in support of the Integrated Strategy promoted by the Municipality of Bologna. The postdoctoral researcher will be responsible for developing the methodological framework, designing and conducting a quantitative survey targeting the main stakeholder groups (residents, students, workers, city users, business operators and visitors), and carrying out qualitative…
